title: Mark All Clears Every Dot
description: One click, and every unread item in the dropdown needs to fall in line — no stragglers left with a dot, no leftover per-item "Mark read" links dangling around.
successCondition: With at least three unread notifications present, clicking "Mark all read" at the top of the dropdown results in: the unread count badge on the bell disappearing entirely, none of the (now at least three) items in the dropdown showing an unread dot, none of them showing a per-item "Mark read" link, and the "Mark all read" button itself remaining visible (since notifications.length is still > 0, only their read state changed).
hints: Generate at least three unread notifications first — booking, paying, and having a shipment delivered are three distinct triggering events documented in docs/api/notifications.md.
The "Mark all read" button's visibility condition is notifications.length > 0, not unreadCount > 0 — it doesn't disappear just because everything's now read.
